display_name: V19真实边界、画面语义与CTA多样化门禁

phases.name: CANDIDATE_PROPOSAL
phases.instructions: Read ${style_profile}, ${package_root}/../../references/semantic/semantic-contract.md and every source ASR item. Emit semantic-candidate-proposal-index/v14 with complete exact-source utterances, including eligible celebrity-led spoken CTA, click-to-play and gift-benefit clauses. Proposals are provisional and cannot enter capacity or plan calculations. Do not invent a requested phrase, substitute so easy, or reuse a user-invalidated interval without a new cut.

phases.name: CANDIDATE_BUILD
phases.instructions: Read ${style_profile}, ${package_root}/../../references/semantic/semantic-contract.md, source ASR, proposals and ${source_frame_evidence_index}. Promote only exact-source speech with completed native evidence. Bind in/mid/out plus multi-frame and audio boundary windows, every-frame celebrity-presence findings, structured live-action/CTA identity, source-internal camera cuts, product mentions and normal-speed boundary listening. Every promoted candidate must carry integer source_in_frame, speech_end_frame, source_out_frame_exclusive, source_fps_num and source_fps_den from decoded evidence; seconds are metadata only. Reject finger flashes, residual impact sounds, preceding/next phonemes, incomplete final characters, lone supporting performers and every old interval globally invalidated by current feedback.

phases.name: IDENTITY_AUDIT
phases.instructions: Assign cross-source person:<stable-id> identities and emit canonical-person-identity-evidence/v11 bound to every candidate and its FFmpeg-decoded in/mid/out frames. Verify every boundary identity; a costume or scene label is not a person identity.

phases.name: SEMANTIC_REVIEW
phases.instructions: Read ${style_profile}, ${package_root}/../../references/semantic/semantic-contract.md. Review exact utterances together with picture, camera changes, full celebrity presence, CTA eligibility and frame/audio windows. One failed reused candidate invalidates every dependent plan. Emit witness_sufficient inventory only after enough valid ordered combinations remain for all requested outputs and replacement margin.

phases.name: GLOBAL_SOLVE
phases.instructions: Read ${style_profile}, ${package_root}/../../references/semantic/semantic-contract.md. Solve all ${requested_outputs} plans together. Enforce a duration range only when the current work order explicitly declares one; otherwise preserve natural source duration and never slow, pad, freeze or add filler to meet a undeclared target. Reuse work only after current-task recheck. Every plan must include a visual-shot table whose longest-shortest spread is at most about three seconds; native same-source camera changes count as separate shots. Copy the exact integer frame bindings and source FPS from approved candidates into every locked-plan segment; never author a seconds-only render interval. Derive reusable rules from concrete user judgments: keep a natural payoff tag attached to its complete result utterance but never isolate it; label and connect mechanism -> survivor acquisition/retention -> result with a real causal relation; reject an unbridged switch from generic system narration to a first-person player statistic; place generic benefit CTA only at the end, bind it to concrete benefit or code content, and put it after proof/result. Enforce exact-source text, no generic so easy substitution, no short filler ending, no weekly-survivor question, no lone supporting performer, no standalone celebrity-player opening, grounded connectors, picture-aware transitions, source-grounded CTA/benefit closes, and batch-level candidate/text/opening/closing/route diversity. Emit a complete-batch capacity witness and current-work-order-bound lock request.

phases.name: CUT_SMOKE_REVIEW
phases.instructions: Review every exact pre-render cut window for identity, empty/black/freeze/double-jump, hard text and crossing speech. For each source_return_visual_risk cut, compare both sides and the earlier use of the returned source for a jarring scene, costume, pose or action reset; reject an unexplained return even when source frame ranges move forward.

phases.name: SOL_FINAL_QC
phases.instructions: Read ${style_profile}, ${package_root}/../../references/semantic/semantic-contract.md. Review picture and sound together at normal speed. Inspect every exact cut for foreign frames, finger flashes, residual impact/phoneme audio and incomplete final characters; inspect celebrity presence, internal camera cuts, semantic/visual compatibility, CTA function, final-shot usefulness and visual-shot duration spread. Reject every dependent output when a shared candidate fails. Emit semantic-sol-output-review/v18 with exact findings and real review-time provenance; return repair_required for any failure.
